questions.question: Describe the features for Personal Portfolio.
questions.answer: Responsive single-page portfolio presenting verified professional information from context.txt, with hero, about, expertise, customer enablement stories, career timeline, recognition, and the verified LinkedIn contact link. Accessible navigation and reduced-motion-aware animation. No backend or contact form; no private analytics, fabricated facts, links, or assets.
questions.rationale: The user requested a fancy personal portfolio based on the attached profile export; these sections fit the source without inventing personal details.
questions.recommendedChoice: Responsive single-page portfolio with an expressive hero, about and expertise sections, selected customer enablement stories, career timeline, recognition, and a LinkedIn contact link. Include keyboard-friendly navigation, subtle reduced-motion-aware animation, and strong mobile layouts. Use only verified facts from context.txt: Rajat Arora, Cloud Solution Architect for AI Apps at Microsoft, Munich, 16 years of experience, Azure and agentic AI expertise, GitHub Copilot Certification, 2026 Microsoft 100% Attainment Award, Siemens hackathon with over 400 developers, Schaeffler hackathon with over 200 developers, and BASF coaching. Label these as coaching and enablement engagements, not independently delivered products. Preserve source career dates, including overlapping Microsoft roles. Contact URL: https://www.linkedin.com/in/thearorarajat . Omit private analytics, recruiter-only details, third-party comments, inferred customer outcomes, fabricated email or GitHub links, stock portraits, and unavailable CV downloads. No contact submission form.

questions.question: Which visual direction should the portfolio use?
questions.rationale: A sophisticated dark editorial treatment suits the user's request for a fancy portfolio and their cloud and AI architecture focus.

options.label: Midnight Atelier
options.description: Recommended: deep ink surfaces, luminous cyan and violet accents, oversized editorial typography, an abstract agent-network hero, and restrained glass cards.

options.label: Editorial Light
options.description: Warm ivory, charcoal type, generous whitespace, precise grid layouts, and cobalt accents.

options.label: Architect's Studio
options.description: Graphite and warm neutrals, technical diagrams, fine rules, and understated lime highlights.
